comments.body:
cc for discussion, not my point, for EL breakout.

EIP-7997 (Factory Deployer) and EIP-7928 (BALs) clarification @nero_eth
> EELS PR: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3200
> EIP PR: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11991

Conflicts with statelessness: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3200#issuecomment-5049399590

cc https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11952/changes

I want to explain my PR and the line of thought to EIP-7997: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12009 to get consensus at this ACD-T, also explaining what should be specified in the EIP, and what should *not* be specified in the EIP. Thanks 😄 👍

In the CL breakout, I would like to discuss the following spec PRs:

* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5472
* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5473

Now that client teams started to look into Hegota implementation it would be good idea if we could discuss general directions on which way we wanna have different testing branches going forward.

One proposed solution is to keep focil and frames separate for quite a while longer.

If we were to keep it this way, we should have a `focil` branch from all clients and a `frames` branch from all el clients.

I would like to discuss making EIP-8070(sparse blobpool) mandatory for glamsterdam devnet 8. But by mandatory, I mean implementing the required Engine APIs (forkchoiceUpdatedV4 with the custody field and getBlobsV4), and keeping eth72 support optional, as implementing it may require significant effort.
